title: R' Yirmiyah Bira
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He reports teachings in Rav Yehudah’s name in Eruvin 25a and Bava Batra 53b. Citing Gittin 34a, Hyman says Rav Yehudah “compelled him” to give his wife a bill of divorce. The passage identifies the husband as Yirmiyah Bira’s son-in-law. In Gittin 35a Rav Yehudah tells Yirmiyah, “Have her take a vow in court.”

notes.text: The consulted Gittin 34a names Yirmiyah Bira’s son-in-law, rather than Yirmiyah himself, as the man compelled to divorce. Hyman’s “him” is retained as a source question. Gittin 35a confirms that Rav Yehudah directs Yirmiyah to administer a vow in court.

The earlier consulted Gittin34a comparison names Yirmiyah Bira’s son-in-law as the compelled husband, while Hyman supplies him. That discrepancy remains explicit; no new manuscript or apparatus witness was inspected. The35a vow instruction is retained as an inherited primary comparison, separate from the family antecedent. Full Rav Yehudah is supplied, whereas heading Yirmiyah’s title remains abbreviated R'. Bira stays a transliteration rather than an identified place.

Hyman’s printed notice (vol. II, p. 815) says “compelled him.” The Gittin 34a passage names the man as Yirmiyah Bira’s son-in-law. The separate instruction in Gittin 35a addresses Yirmiyah and distinguishes a vow in court from an oath outside court. The Bava Batra statement begins on 53b and continues on 54a.
